title: Location Resilience splits geo-restriction into feature-hiding and total denial of service
content:
A.5.4.1 defines two distinct tiers of geographic restriction for frontends operated by Ecosystem Actors.

**Limited filtering** (A.5.4.1.3) requires frontends to avoid displaying or describing specific features to flagged IPs — enumerated in A.5.4.1.3.1 as Staking Rewards, the Sky Savings Rate, and any other yield- or reward-related feature. Service continues; only the *yield surface* disappears.

**Full Block** (A.5.4.1.4) requires denying service of any kind, and A.5.4.1.4.1 names the jurisdictions (Cuba, Iran, Syria, North Korea, Afghanistan, Belarus, Burma, Russia, Venezuela, Crimea and Sevastopol, and the Donetsk People's Republic).

The two-tier design tracks the distinction between sanctions exposure and securities exposure: full blocks follow sanctions lists, while limited filtering removes precisely the yield messaging that attracts investment-contract characterisation. A.5.4.1.2 attaches penalties for non-compliance, making this binding rather than advisory.
description: Limited filtering hides yield-related features (Staking Rewards, Sky Savings Rate) from flagged IPs; Full Block denies service entirely to a named list of jurisdictions.
